newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon unit enters pact with Coca-Cola.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon unit enters pact with Coca-Cola.

text.p: Raytheon Engineers and Constructors said on Monday that it had entered into a long-term agreement with the Coca-Cola Co to accelerate the building of Coca-Cola facilities.
Through the alliance, Raytheon will provide design, engineering, and construction services in nearly 50 countries around the world, Raytheon said in a statement.

"Raytheon Engineers and Constructors will help to reduce costs and cut scheduled implementation time. These approaches should result in enhanced value creation through investment in infrastructure," said Ken Dietz, Raytheon Engineers and Constructors vice president of food and consumer products.
Raytheon did not elaborate on terms of the agreement.
Raytheon Engineers and Constructors is one of four business segments of Raytheon Co.
